description: This file defines the SugarFeedDashlet class, a PHP class that extends DashletGeneric to implement a customizable dashboard widget (dashlet) for the SugarCRM platform. It manages the display, configuration, and interaction of a social feed interface within the SugarCRM ecosystem, including fetching external APIs, handling user interactions, and rendering content.

classes.name: SugarFeedDashlet
classes.description: Represents a customizable dashboard widget for displaying a social feed within SugarCRM, capable of fetching, displaying, and managing social media content and integrations.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the dashlet with configurations such as categories, external APIs, and display settings.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Fetches and prepares data for display, including security filtering and external API integration.

methods.name: deleteUserFeed
methods.description: Deletes a specific user feed entry if permission allows.

methods.name: pushUserFeed
methods.description: Posts a new user message to the feed.

methods.name: pushUserFeedReply
methods.description: Posts a reply to an existing feed entry.

methods.name: displayOptions
methods.description: Renders the configuration options UI for the dashlet.

methods.name: saveOptions
methods.description: Saves user-selected configuration options for the dashlet.

methods.name: sugarFeedDisplayScript
methods.description: Returns JavaScript code to enable feed display functionalities.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Renders the complete dashlet UI, including content, security filtering, and external API data.

methods.name: getHeader
methods.description: Generates the header HTML for the dashlet, including post form and scripts.

methods.name: getDisabledWarning
methods.description: Returns a warning message if the feed system is disabled.

methods.name: getPostForm
methods.description: Generates the HTML form for users to post new feed entries.

methods.name: shouldDisplay
methods.description: Static method that checks if the SugarFeed dashlet should be available, based on admin settings.

methods.name: check_enabled
methods.description: Checks if specific modules (e.g., Twitter, Facebook) are enabled via configuration.
